description: Suijin OS v6.6.0 — The Web Evidence Engine. Coverage ledger with evidence-required marking, surface_expand sibling enumeration, same-surface stall detection, XSS impact-exploration playbooks (OAuth chaining, token exfil, authenticated reads), FILTERED-NEVER-SAFE escalation doctrine. capability audit CI gate: orphans are build failures (301 routes at full parity; the dead testssl/wafw00f packs fixed). 2,055+ tests green.
